blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Travelers get a slight reprieve in the second half of November as the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) approved lower fuel surcharges for the period, reflecting the decline in global jet fuel prices. In an advisory, the aviation regulator said a Level 16 fuel surcharge would take effect from Nov. 16 to 30, down one notch from Level 17 during the first half of the month.
